title: End-to-End Reliability, Performance Profiling & Integration QA
database_migration: No schema changes. All protected scientific/reporting databases remain on their 11.17 schemas.
headline_features: Cross-workspace integrity audit across Fields, Experiments, Persistent Twin, Research Evidence and Reports.
Active persisted workflow-chain readiness from mapped field through measured outcome and report.
Bounded in-session top-level and embedded-tool performance profiling with median/P95/max/error summaries.
Safe queued routing for Fields & Operations and remaining Home cross-workspace shortcuts.
Synthetic end-to-end persisted workflow regression in the release verifier using temporary database copies.
limitations: Integration checks establish structural/reference continuity only, not scientific validity.
Session performance timings are workload/hardware dependent and are not standardized benchmarks.
Full interactive Streamlit browser verification requires the target Windows/Anaconda environment.
